title: Part-time community college student (with family, overnight warehouse four nights, 3 classes, Canvas) texts 'I'm swamped' on Friday afternoon with four things due Sunday to Tuesday; Dev acts: three blocks in her after-class and Sunday windows with Undo, nothing around her night shifts or Sunday dinner.

changes.content: I'm swamped. Bio quiz and English post are due Sunday, Psych quiz Monday, Bio worksheet Tuesday, and I'm at work all weekend nights.

dev_must_notice.what: Four items in four days (m-swamped): Bio chapter quiz 13 and English discussion 13 Sun Nov 22 11:59 PM (asg-bio-105-chapter-quiz-13, asg-eng-101-discussion-post-13), Psych module quiz 12 Mon Nov 23 (asg-psy-101-module-quiz-12), Bio lab worksheet 13 Tue Nov 24 (asg-bio-105-lab-worksheet-13). She works Friday and Saturday nights 10 PM to 6:30 AM and sleeps 7:15 AM to about 2 PM after. Her real study time is Sunday 3:30 to 6 PM and Monday and Tuesday after class from 3 PM; Sunday dinner with her mom and brothers is 6:30 to 7:45 PM.

best_fix.what: Dev acts and says in two lines: 'Four things, and your real time covers all of them. I put three blocks on your calendar: Sunday 3:30 to 5:30 PM for the Bio quiz and the English post, Monday 3:00 to 4:30 PM for the Psych quiz, Tuesday 3:00 to 4:30 PM for the Bio worksheet. Tap Undo to remove any.' Nothing tonight or Saturday.
best_fix.why: The blocks use the windows she has: Sunday afternoon before dinner, Monday and Tuesday after class (Monday English ends 1:15 PM, Tuesday's Bio lab ends 2:20 PM). Her nights and her post-night sleep are left whole. Undo is shown.

tempting.suggestion: book study Friday or Saturday afternoon or evening before her night shift, or on Sunday evening during dinner
tempting.why_wrong: she sleeps until about 2 PM after nights and needs the rest before the next shift; Sunday 6:30 PM is family dinner and Sunday night is her one real night of sleep

must_not: book study Friday or Saturday before a night shift, or in her post-night sleep (7:15 AM to 2 PM)
book over Sunday dinner (6:30 to 7:45 PM) or Sunday night's sleep
suggest using her saved unpaid time off hours (m-upt) or skipping a shift
do, write or check the quizzes, post or worksheet
use guilt words or say she is overcommitted
book study Friday or Saturday afternoon or evening before her night shift, or on Sunday evening during dinner
assumptions: The simulator's Sunday after a Saturday night shift ends 6:30 AM, so her Sunday afternoon is awake time; her usual Sunday study window is 3:30 to 6 PM.
Today's four items already exist in Canvas; Dev adds blocks only, never tasks that aren't there.
